english.title: Stop a vehicle within crossing limits of parallel crossing
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[driver]_
(B)_[rider]_

of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), caused it or a part of it to stop within the limits of a Parallel crossing on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary paragraph 21(1)(a), Part 1, Schedule 14 of the Traffic Signs Regulations and General Directions 2016, section 25(5) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The Zebra, Pelican and Puffin Pedestrian Crossings Regulations 1997 are repealed from 22nd April 2016, However, these regulations remain in force in relation to Pelican crossings that were established prior to 22nd October 2016 (6 months from the date of repeal) by virtue of regulation 14(5) of the Traffic Signs Regulations and General Directions 2016. This is because Pelican Crossings are to be gradually phased out.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant caused **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) to stop within the limits of a Parallel crossing on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..).

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

No endorsement or disqualification if offence committed in respect of a non-motor vehicle.

Fixed penalty ticket - one hundred pounds and licence endorsed three penalty points.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
